scenarios.name: Rename an inactive model state through the table

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user creates a fourth model state named Model State1 and reactivates Copy State
The MCAD Software has an active Copy State and an inactive Model State1
no model state is named Table Variant
the user opens the model-state table
changes the Model State1 member cell to "Table Variant"
the model browser shows Table Variant in place of Model State1
